title: ci(test-ui): select a cross-package test when a package it reads is affected, not on every run
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb77KgkSa7rZ7QmbAP6hZdVB)_

Part-of #31520 (slice 1 of 3 planned; the card closes only when the empty-diff count is under 200 and the three-PR shard reading is on it)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Test UI 的选测脚本不再把「跨包引用」的测试当作每次必跑;它们只在所引用的包被改动时才跑。空改动下的必跑集从 691 个文件降到 579 个。
- 为什么改:一个只改一行的 UI PR 也要跑完这 691 个必跑文件;其中 112 个只是引用了别的包,包图本可以定位它们。
- 风险与回滚:风险是某个测试在它读的包变了时没被选中;已用 34 个单包改动逐一比对旧新两版,没有一个测试丢掉它该有的选中。回滚即还原这一个脚本。
- 先看:`ui/scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs` 里 `attributed` 那段(依据所触及的包选中),然后是测试文件里新增的 `attributed test files` 一组。
- 两分钟验证:`cd ui && node scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs --base origin/main --explain`,预期 `always-on test files ...: 579`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs` had four always-on reasons. Two of them, "reaches PKG outside OWNER" and "imports NAME, which OWNER does not depend on", named a workspace package the selector could already place. Those tests now get **input packages**: their own package, every package their relative import closure has a file in, and every workspace package that closure imports by name. A test is selected, as a file filter, whenever one of its input packages is affected. Because the affected set already includes dependents, a change to a package that a reached package depends on selects the test too.

What stays always-on is unchanged: tests outside every package, tests whose closure reads the disk or spawns a process, and tests that reach a file outside every package (`scripts/`, the tree root). `--explain` prints the attributed files and the packages that selected each one. The header (new item 2a) says why the edge is attributed rather than declared. Declaring it in `package.json` would make the test's whole package a dependent of the target. On this tree, three of the five undeclared edges would also be cycles: `core`↔`plugin-map`, `core`↔`i18n`, `react`↔`plugin-grid`.

Empty-diff count, `cd ui && node scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs --base origin/main --explain`:

| head | always-on | selected of tracked |
|---|---:|---:|
| `f4b1f9ee` (branch base) | 691 | 691 of 6,658 |
| `a3ac7fb3` (`origin/main` merged in, main's selector) | 691 | 691 of 6,658 |
| `1f0dd719` (this PR, after merging `a3ac7fb3`) | 579 | 579 of 6,658 |

## Why

Slice 1 of the plan the `domain:ui#3` seat approved on #31520: class (a) of the card's classification, the 112 always-on tests whose only edges past their package go into other packages. Slices 2 (disk readers whose reads resolve inside named packages) and 3 (`scripts/` and `eslint-rules/` as owner directories) follow as separate PRs.

## Tests

In `ui/scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests.test.ts`, the fixture gains `packages/c/src/reach.test.ts`, which imports a file of `@fx/b`, which in turn depends on `@fx/a`. The existing `undeclared.test.ts` imports `@fx/a` by name without declaring it.

- Positive controls: a change in `@fx/a` selects `undeclared.test.ts` (through `@fx/a`). A change in `@fx/b` selects `reach.test.ts` (through `@fx/b`). A change in `@fx/a` also selects `reach.test.ts` (through `@fx/a` and `@fx/b`), which is the case the seat asked for: a package the reached package depends on.
- Negative controls: a docs-only change leaves both out of the always-on set and out of the filters. A change in an unrelated package (`@fx/registry`) selects neither. A change in their own package selects them through the package directory, not as attributed files. `escapes.test.ts`, which reaches `scripts/`, stays always-on.
- The old pin that `undeclared.test.ts` is always-on is replaced by the attribution pins above.

<details><summary>Ablation: the selector at the base, the new controls red</summary>

With the fix committed (`80935d1b`), the selector was restored to `f4b1f9ee` on disk (`grep -c attributed` gave 0 on disk against 7 at HEAD). The test file at HEAD was then run: 6 failed, 38 passed. The failures were the six new cases: "does not keep a test whose only edges past its package are into other packages", the three "selects a test when ..." cases, "does not select either ...", and "a change to its own package ...". The selector was then restored from `HEAD`, and `git hash-object` matched the HEAD blob `6b5a98a0`. `git diff HEAD` was empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Exactness sweep: no test loses a selection it needs</summary>

For each workspace package with a tracked `src/` file (38 packages; core, i18n, test-support and types are full-run triggers under both versions), the base selector and this one were each run on a one-file change in that package. Across the 34 affected-mode runs, 1,891 test-file selections were dropped and 0 were added. For every dropped one, an independent check of the test's relative closure confirmed it has no file in an affected package's directory, imports no affected package by name, reads no disk, and reaches no non-package file.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The card's second acceptance line will read 16 shards on every UI PR, whatever the always-on count.** `node scripts/ci-shard-matrix.mjs` reads `test-ui 16 literal`; Test Core's matrix is `planned`. On PR run 42478811805 (a console-only fix), the 16 Test UI shards took 3,368 runner-seconds, 59% of it in the test step. This PR shrinks only that step. The seat has taken the matrix question to the maintainer. It would be a `ci.yml` change, which is out of scope here.
- The step-1 classification of all 691 files is in the card thread's project files (`issue-31520/classification.md`). On that measurement, slices 1 to 3 reach about 393, and under 200 needs a further decision recorded on the card.

## Verification

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `80935d1b`: 20 families. All 20 were run locally on that head and reconciled with `--ran`, which reported "20 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)". `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` was also run, as the ui seat requires on every card.

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (under the verify lock): 170 test files passed and 2 were skipped, the skips being existing conditional skips. 5,002 tests passed.
- On `1f0dd719`, after merging `a3ac7fb3`: the selector's own two suites passed again (2 files, 54 tests), and `--explain` printed 579. The merge brought in no `ui/scripts/` change.
- No changeset: `ui/` is the private `object-ui-monorepo` root, and `ui/scripts/` ships in no package, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.
- CI runs the rest: the PR's required check-runs.
